name: DeleteFile
label: Delete File(s)
description: Deletes one or more files. Supports wildcards and multiple file paths separated by semicolons.

fields.name: FilesToDelete
fields.label: File(s) to Delete
fields.description: The path(s) of the file(s) to delete, separated by semicolons (;). Supports wildcards. Examples: C:\Temp\report.pdf | C:\Temp\*.log;C:\Archive\old_*.txt
